subject: Billing orchestration for ACME: PO timing & invoice sequencing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Jordan Bates <jordan@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing orchestration for ACME: PO timing & invoice sequencing

Hi Jordan / ACME procurement team,

Quick note to align on the invoicing choreography so we hit your bookings recognition window cleanly. We want to avoid any mismatch between PO issuance, invoice submission, and the ACME month-end close that would push recognition into the next quarter.

High-level ask: can you confirm the expected PO issue date and the earliest invoice acceptance date for this engagement? That will determine whether we send the first invoice in the current month or schedule it for the start of the next recognition period.

I've attached our updated proposal (Redwood-Proposal-v2.pdf) and a blank ACME_PO_Template.xlsx to make PO creation easier. Suggested cadence:
- PO signed by ACME by 5/28 -> Redwood invoices on 6/01 (covers May usage; target recognition in Jun)
- If PO arrives after 5/28, invoice moves to 6/15 to align with your AR cycle and avoid partial-period recognition

If helpful I can share an .ics with the invoicing cutoffs for your calendar. Laura and Marissa are looped in for finance confirmation.

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply so we can schedule DocuSign and ticket routing.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
--
Attachment: Redwood-Proposal-v2.pdf (proposal, 6 pages)
Attachment: ACME_PO_Template.xlsx (Excel template, fillable)

From: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Bates <jordan@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing orchestration for ACME: PO timing & invoice sequencing

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear note. A few items from our side:

1) PO timing: Procurement aims to issue the PO by EOD Friday 2027-05-28, pending final legal review. We will confirm by Thursday if there are any redlines.
2) Invoice acceptance: Our AR team will accept invoices with an invoice date up to 2027-06-05 for recognition in June. Anything dated after that will likely fall into the July close.
3) PO format: Your ACME_PO_Template.xlsx will be fine; we will populate and return with a signature block.

One caveat: if DocuSign routing is used, our internal signing queue can add ~48 hours. Can Redwood accommodate a soft invoice date (e.g., 2027-06-01) if the PO signs on 5/29 but DocuSign completes on 5/31?

Jordan Bates
CFO, Acme Corporation
procurement@acme.com
--
(we will also send a formal PO number once the template is returned)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Jordan Bates <jordan@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing orchestration for ACME: Billing orchestration for ACME: PO timing & invoice sequencing

Thanks Jordan — that's very helpful context. Short answers: yes, we can accommodate a soft invoice date to match your AR acceptance policy. Proposed concrete plan to avoid any recognition slip: 

- Target: ACME PO signed by 2027-05-28 -> Redwood issues invoice dated 2027-06-01 with net-30 payment terms.
- If PO completes 2027-05-29–05/31 and DocuSign completes by 2027-05-31, Redwood will still issue invoice dated 2027-06-01 (soft date; we can note DocuSign ID).
- If PO or DocuSign completes after 2027-05-31, we shift invoice to 2027-06-15; Redwood will tag the invoice for the June recognition bucket only if AR accepts per your earlier note (<= 2027-06-05).

I've attached invoice_windows_calendar.ics — drop that on your calendar; it includes the cutoff reminders and the proposed DocuSign window. Laura/Marissa: please confirm we are comfortable with the soft-date approach and that revenue ops will mark the recognition accordingly so finance can book in June.

Hannah
--
Attachment: invoice_windows_calendar.ics (calendar invite, 3 events)

Subject: Re: Billing orchestration for ACME: PO timing & invoice sequencing — finance confirmation

All — confirming finance reviewed the proposed flow and we are aligned with the soft-invoice-date approach given ACME's AR acceptance window. Action items: 

- Marissa: once we receive the signed PO (ACME to return ACME_PO_Template.xlsx with PO number), create a billing ticket and assign to Ben for invoice prep.
- Ben: prepare invoice using Redwood invoice template; set invoice date per Hannah's guidance (2027-06-01 if DocuSign done by 5/31, otherwise 6/15). Add a note in the invoice memo referencing DocuSign transaction ID and the PO number.
- Vivek: please mark the ACME opportunity as commit for June bookings once Marissa confirms PO number received.

I'll loop in Collections if we see any deviation. Hannah — can you confirm you'll forward the DocuSign link when you initiate signing so our AR team can monitor acceptance?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
